set.name: 谅解条约
set.from: 领主大厅尾王房间 · 宝库门后的石板
set.instructions: 在杜尔根·挽歌之锤所在的最终房间，拾取宝库门后石板上的谅解条约，触发任务后交给铁炉堡的麦格尼·铜须国王。
set.instructionsEn: Pick up the treaty on the stone tablet behind the vault door in Durgen's final room. Start the quest and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

set.prerequisites: 黑铁地图 → 地下地图 → 旧铁炉堡入侵

set.instructions: 在影牙城堡寻找亡灵哨兵。任务在副本庭院内向亡灵哨兵文森特交付，不需要返回瑟伯切尔交付。
set.instructionsEn: Find the deathstalkers in Shadowfang Keep. Turn the quest in to Deathstalker Vincent in the dungeon courtyard, not back at the Sepulcher.

set.instructions: 术士职业任务：在黑暗深渊收集 3 块索兰鲁克碎片；大块碎片需在影牙城堡取得。两处材料收齐后交给贫瘠之地的杜安·卡汉。
set.instructionsEn: Warlock quest: collect 3 Soran'ruk Fragments in Blackfathom Deeps and the Large Fragment in Shadowfang Keep. Return to Doan Karhan in the Barrens.

set.instructions: 联盟圣骑士职业任务材料：在黑暗深渊取得科尔宝石相关材料，到奥伯丁找桑迪斯·织风完成净化。其余材料涉及死亡矿井、影牙城堡和洛克莫丹。
set.instructionsEn: Alliance paladin quest material: recover the Kor Gem material from Blackfathom Deeps and have Thundris Windweaver purify it in Auberdine. Other materials come from the Deadmines, Shadowfang Keep and Loch Modan.

set.instructions: 联盟圣骑士职业任务材料：在死亡矿井取得白石橡木。其余材料涉及影牙城堡、黑暗深渊和洛克莫丹，收齐后交给乔丹·斯迪威尔。
set.instructionsEn: Alliance paladin quest material: obtain Whitestone Oak Lumber in the Deadmines. Other materials come from Shadowfang Keep, Blackfathom Deeps and Loch Modan; return them to Jordan Stilwell.
